title: Service tokens
hint: Read-only tokens for other applications, e.g. Astrolabe. The secret is shown once. An expired token keeps its name until you revoke it.
name: Name

created.title: Token created: {{name}}
created.warning: Copy it now, it is never shown again. Flow stores only a digest of it, so a lost token cannot be recovered, only revoked and replaced.

empty: No service tokens yet. Create the first one above.
loadFailed: Could not load the service tokens
revokeBody: "{{name}}" stops working immediately and cannot be restored. Any application using it loses access until you give it a new token.

error.forbidden: Only administrators can manage service tokens.
error.invalid: The name is invalid: 1–100 characters, a single line, no control characters.
error.nameTaken: A token with this name already exists and is not revoked. An expired token keeps its name until you revoke it, so pick another name or revoke the old token first.
error.failed: Could not create the token. Check your connection and try again.
error.revokeFailed: Could not revoke the token. Check your connection and try again.
